showD: Turn each kind on or off. The alerts you see are on the Alerts page and at the top of Home.

types.jars: Payments that look like they came from a jar
types.card: Card charge much higher than last month
types.recon: Books do not match the bank
types.pending: Charges the bank still lists as pending
types.sync: A source is out of date

whenD: The amounts that trigger the alerts above.
